_comment: Lives at .metaframework/project.json. Written once at C4 anchor. Every {placeholder} is substituted by the caller. Declared, never inferred: the framework is language-agnostic, so no discovery heuristic is safe.
_test_notes: test_command is the gate: full suite, every run, no scoping. test_module is the inner loop while building one rung. test_select runs one named test and is what CC-6's mutation battery invokes with the Test name from S3 §5.
_php_notes: A PHP build (2.6.13): declare the library's PSR-4 namespace in composer.json before the first class, then e.g. test_command 'vendor/bin/phpunit', test_module 'vendor/bin/phpunit tests/{module}', test_select 'vendor/bin/phpunit --filter {test_name}', isolation_test_command 'python tools/isolation-run.py -- vendor/bin/phpunit --filter IsolationTest', source_glob 'src/**/*.php'. PHP isolation tests are tests/**/<Class>IsolationTest.php unless object_standard.isolation_test_pattern says otherwise. See governance/languages/php.md.
_typecheck_notes: typecheck_command: a TypeScript project's type check over the library AND ui/, e.g. 'npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.ui.json' with a tsconfig whose include covers src/ and ui/ (and the DOM lib where views run in a browser). Phase 5 runs it with seal.py verify at the end of each Build batch, because Vite and esbuild strip types without checking them. null in a TypeScript project is a dead gate; Phase 5 asks once and records it. Not used for other languages.
_rubric_versions_notes: rubric_versions: the versions tools/receipts.py uses, e.g. {"k7_verdict": 2, "owner_triage": 2}. null means version 1 of each, as setup admits them. Declare it only when the owner has admitted newer versions: a store whose judged rubrics were admitted from the Markdown specs (plugin 2.6.9 or earlier) is refused every judged act by the seal-4 engine until the owner runs the lines `python tools/receipts.py migrate --signer <principal>` prints, which end with the value to declare here.
_pipelinegate_notes: pipelinegate_command (RD-28): the plugin's PipelineGate tool face over this repo's own store, e.g. 'python "<plugin>/skills/pipelinegate/scripts/pg.py" --store .pipelinegate'. Declared, the gates are receipts: credit is read from standing at k7 and owner-triage, and gate.py needs the owner's receipts for a closed-by-owner tag. The owner signs the store's catalog first (python tools/receipts.py setup --signer <principal> prints the commands). Undeclared, credited review runs from the verdict files alone (RD-27).
_isolation_notes: isolation_test_command: runs the OS-12 isolation tests with the environment cleared and the clock frozen (e.g. 'python tools/isolation-run.py -- npx vitest run .isolation.'; a Python build's is 'python tools/isolation-run.py'). tools/isolation-run.py clears the environment the same way on Windows, which has no env -i, and on POSIX (2.7.0). This is the rule's real proof: a scanner cannot show absence, but a class that reaches for anything it was not handed fails to construct in an empty environment. The seal sweep runs it; undeclared, it is carried forward as an open item.
_object_standard_notes: object_standard: tuning for the Object Writing Standard check (governance/Object_Writing_Standard.md). Keys: ambient_patterns [[regex, rule, fix], ...], bucket_names [..], isolation_test_pattern (default tests/**/*{stem}*.isolation.*, set null to skip OS-12), allow {path_prefix: [rule, ...]} for documented exceptions, skip true to disable. null means the built-in defaults, which cover JS/TS, Python and PHP (PHP's own ambient patterns in tools/php_support.py apply to .php files unless ambient_patterns is set).
_ui_render_notes: ui_render_command: how Phase 5 renders a view to an image for side-by-side comparison, e.g. a headless-browser screenshot taking {url} and {out}. Phase 5 reviews rendered images, not source; an undeclared command is a dead gate.
_seal_notes: sealed_globs: files matching these at the latest seal-* tag are frozen by gate.py and checked by seal.py verify. null means [source_glob, "tests/**"]. Vectors are not sealed: rederive checks them against sealed code. ui_root is Phase 5's tree and must not match source_glob, or CC-1 will demand object-model rows for UI files.
_documents_notes: s3_document: the frozen CLAUDE_<Concept>_Phase3.md under governance/S3/. s2_document: the Phase 2 CLAUDE_<Concept>_Phase2.md, committed with the repo. Both are review basis (tools/basis.py): tools/brief.py quotes the module's rows from them, gate.py refuses a builder's launch whose brief predates a change to either, and k7-run.py shows the reviewer the same digests. emission-check runs on them in K7's preflight.
_gates_notes: 2.6.17. project_hooks: every hooks/*.py this project writes (S3 §7's code-level hooks), each run by tools/precommit.py on every commit with the staged paths as arguments; a non-zero exit refuses the commit. phase4-checks.py gates fails while a hooks/*.py is unlisted. code_gates: true once the oop-standards bundle's code-gates is adopted (C4: node <gates.cjs> init, without --git-hook, after the template commit), and exactly when .code-gates.json exists; tools/install-gates.py --code-gates <gates.cjs> records where gates.cjs is on this machine, in .metaframework/local.json (not committed).
_scaffold_notes: null on either key uses the built-in set — the defaults live in tools/phase4-checks.py so there is one place to change them. Setting an array here REPLACES the default rather than adding to it, so if you override scaffold_exempt, carry over .metaframework/, tools/, and governance/S2-S3-emission-contract.md. The scanning tool must sit in an exempt directory or it matches its own patterns, and the emission contract is exempt because documenting a filename template is not leakage. governance/S3/ is deliberately not exempt: an unsubstituted placeholder in a frozen spec is a real defect.
_tabletop_notes: Adopted onto plugin 2.9.1 on 2026-11-08 (R1, I-261); the build predates the template. Vectors are pinned JSON in vectors/ and re-derived inside the vitest suite (each vector's test recomputes from the implementation and compares to the pin), so rederive_command selects a vector's tests by name; porting them to tools/rederive.py's rederive_invoke form is R1's seal-session work. source_glob covers the engine, presentation and patterns packages; the BOTY content pack (packs/boty) and sealed_globs, typecheck_command, isolation_test_command and code_gates are set by the R1 build session. R1 (2026-11-08): object_standard.allow takes OS-2 for seven exact files under SR-1 (I-262: function-local lets the 2.9.1 pattern reads as module state); scaffold_exempt carries the defaults and adds two documents that quote a marker as content (I-263); rederive stays inside vitest (the seal and K7 run rederive_all; no port needed).
